about: Illustrative problem bodies of RD05-Y (application/problem+json, RFC 9457). Placeholder values only; no endpoint is implemented.

invalid-request.title: Invalid request
invalid-request.detail: The request is malformed or a required header is missing.

idempotency-key-required.title: Idempotency key required
idempotency-key-required.detail: This operation needs an Idempotency-Key header.

session-expired.title: Session expired
session-expired.detail: The session has ended. Sign in again.

credentials-invalid.title: Credentials invalid
credentials-invalid.detail: The email or password is incorrect.

access-denied.title: Access denied
access-denied.detail: The account has no access to this area.

consent-required.title: Consent required
consent-required.detail: The consent module is not granted.

not-available.title: Not available
not-available.detail: The resource is missing, expired or outside your scope.

job-closed.title: Job closed
job-closed.detail: The job no longer accepts applications.

job-version-changed.title: Job version changed
job-version-changed.detail: A newer job version has been published.

notice-version-changed.title: Notice version changed
notice-version-changed.detail: The consent notice changed. Read it and decide again.

resume-not-ready.title: CV not ready
resume-not-ready.detail: The resume version is not Ready.

submission-blocked.title: Submission blocked
submission-blocked.detail: The application cannot be submitted yet.

already-submitted.title: Already submitted
already-submitted.detail: These answers were already submitted and cannot be changed.

invalid-state.title: Invalid state
invalid-state.detail: The operation is not allowed in the current status.

draft-incomplete.title: Draft incomplete
draft-incomplete.detail: The job draft cannot be reviewed or published yet.

last-admin.title: Last Admin
last-admin.detail: The organization must keep at least one Admin.

invitation-expired.title: Invitation expired
invitation-expired.detail: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.

confirmation-required.title: Confirmation required
confirmation-required.detail: Confirm the stated consequences and repeat the request.

request-in-progress.title: Request in progress
request-in-progress.detail: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still being processed.

version-mismatch.title: Version mismatch
version-mismatch.detail: The resource changed since it was read.

file-too-large.title: File too large
file-too-large.detail: The file is larger than the limit. Nothing was uploaded.

pdf-too-many-pages.title: Too many pages
pdf-too-many-pages.detail: The PDF has more pages than the limit. Nothing was uploaded.

text-too-long.title: Extracted text too long
text-too-long.detail: The extracted text exceeds the limit. Nothing was uploaded.

pdf-scanned.title: Scanned PDF not supported
pdf-scanned.detail: Scanned or image-only PDFs are not supported yet.

span-invalid.title: Selected text does not match
span-invalid.detail: The selected span does not match the CV text.

validation-failed.title: Validation failed
validation-failed.detail: One or more fields are invalid.

idempotency-key-reused.title: Idempotency key reused
idempotency-key-reused.detail: This Idempotency-Key was used with a different request.

precondition-required.title: Precondition required
precondition-required.detail: Send If-Match with the version you read.

too-many-attempts.title: Too many attempts
too-many-attempts.detail: Too many attempts. Try again later.

service-unavailable.title: Service unavailable
service-unavailable.detail: A temporary problem on our side. Nothing was changed.
